integrity.proof_scope: A general descent/normalization proof plus complete finite integral group calculation; no extrapolation from finite-field samples.

scientific_limitations: The statements concern stable reducible nodal graph curves of arithmetic genus eight, not smooth curves.
Only twists by the point-line-preserving subgroup GL_3(F_2) of the full Heawood automorphism group are classified.
The Picard group statement is about the connected identity component, with no claim about other multidegrees.
The general normalization and graph-curve constructions are classical and are not originality claims.
Historical priority beyond the inspected sources remains subject to independent literature review.
title: Five integral Picard tori of the Fano-plane Heawood stable curve
